full_reference: Keys, R. G. (1981). Cubic Convolution Interpolation for Digital Image Processing. IEEE Transactions on Acoustics Speech and Signal Processing 29(6), 1153-1160.
reported_results: Derives a separable cubic-convolution interpolation whose approximation order lies between linear interpolation and cubic splines under the stated conditions.
limitations: It is an interpolation analysis rather than learned SR and does not evaluate document or notation semantics.
relevance_to_tfg: Defines the transparent bicubic baseline family but cannot establish score fidelity on its own.

full_reference: Dong, C., Loy, C. C., He, K., and Tang, X. (2015). Image Super-Resolution Using Deep Convolutional Networks. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 38(2), 295-307.
reported_results: Reports improved reconstruction quality over contemporary example-based methods and a direct end-to-end CNN mapping.
limitations: Uses small natural-image benchmarks and synthetic bicubic degradation; no document or score-semantic evaluation.
relevance_to_tfg: Establishes the CNN foundation and the limits of bicubic-trained natural-image evidence.

full_reference: Lim, B., Son, S., Kim, H., Nah, S., and Lee, K. M. (2017). Enhanced Deep Residual Networks for Single Image Super-Resolution. CVPR Workshops, 136-144.
data: DIV2K training; Set5, Set14, B100, Urban100 evaluation
reported_results: Reports challenge-winning distortion-oriented performance and 34.78 dB / 0.9708 on the illustrated DIV2K 0853 4x example for EDSR+.
limitations: Primarily synthetic bicubic natural-image evidence; a figure-specific value is not a cross-dataset aggregate and no score semantics are tested.
relevance_to_tfg: Represents a residual fidelity-oriented family for later comparison criteria without selecting its weights.

full_reference: Ledig, C., Theis, L., Huszar, F., Caballero, J., Cunningham, A., Acosta, A., Aitken, A., Tejani, A., Totz, J., Wang, Z., and Shi, W. (2017). Photo-Realistic Single Image Super-Resolution Using a Generative Adversarial Network. CVPR, 4681-4690.
data: ImageNet training; Set5, Set14, BSD100 evaluation
method: Residual generator with adversarial and VGG-feature content losses
reported_results: Reports MOS values closer to original high-resolution images than competing SR methods while acknowledging lower pixel-distortion scores than MSE-oriented solutions.
limitations: Human natural-image realism does not establish faithful recovery of notation; adversarial detail can be plausible without being source-correct.
relevance_to_tfg: Introduces the perceptual-versus-pixel-fidelity tension that requires explicit semantic error checks.

full_reference: Blau, Y., and Michaeli, T. (2018). The Perception-Distortion Tradeoff. CVPR, 6228-6237.
data: Analytical distributions and SR algorithm comparisons
reported_results: Proves a monotone perception-distortion boundary under the paper's definitions and proposes evaluating algorithms in the perception-distortion plane.
limitations: The theory does not define music-semantic correctness and its perceptual distribution criterion is not a substitute for notation-level review.
relevance_to_tfg: Justifies complementary metrics and blocks claims that sharper or lower-distortion output is automatically safer.

full_reference: Wang, X., Yu, K., Wu, S., Gu, J., Liu, Y., Dong, C., Qiao, Y., and Loy, C. C. (2018). ESRGAN: Enhanced Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Networks. ECCV Workshops.
data: DIV2K, Flickr2K, and PIRM-SR challenge data
method: RRDB generator with relativistic adversarial and pre-activation perceptual losses
reported_results: Reports first place in PIRM2018-SR challenge region 3 and improved perceptual quality over SRGAN.
limitations: The paper explicitly notes hallucinated details/artifacts in the predecessor; natural-image perceptual quality does not validate musical symbols.
relevance_to_tfg: Provides primary evidence that realistic texture generation carries artifact and hallucination concerns.

full_reference: Tran, M.-T., and Lee, G.-S. (2019). Super-resolution in Music Score Images by Instance Normalization. Smart Media Journal 8(4), 64-71.
degradation: Low-resolution images paired to higher-resolution targets
metrics: Source reports comparative image-quality evaluation without accessible metric detail
reported_results: Reports that the proposed instance-normalized network outperforms the compared existing methods on DeepScores.
limitations: Accessible primary metadata does not expose full split protocol numeric table code weights or licence; one dataset and synthetic setup cannot establish broad professional validity.
relevance_to_tfg: Directly establishes prior score-image SR while motivating a more traceable and semantics-aware evaluation.

full_reference: Liang, J., Cao, J., Sun, G., Zhang, K., Van Gool, L., and Timofte, R. (2021). SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer. ICCV Workshops, 1833-1844.
data: DIV2K, Flickr2K, Set5, Set14, BSD100, Urban100, Manga109, and real-image sets
reported_results: Reports gains of up to 0.14-0.45 dB and parameter reductions up to 67% across the studied restoration tasks.
limitations: Task-dependent maxima are not one universal result; the work evaluates natural images rather than notation semantics.
relevance_to_tfg: Establishes windowed-transformer restoration evidence and both controlled and real-world task distinctions.

full_reference: Wang, X., Xie, L., Dong, C., and Shan, Y. (2021). Real-ESRGAN: Training Real-World Blind Super-Resolution With Pure Synthetic Data. ICCV Workshops, 1905-1914.
data: DF2K and synthetic training pairs; multiple real image sets
degradation: Second-order blur resizing noise JPEG and ringing/overshoot simulation
method: ESRGAN-derived generator with high-order degradation synthesis and U-Net discriminator
metrics: Non-reference perceptual metrics and qualitative comparison
reported_results: Reports superior visual performance over prior methods on the studied real datasets and provides on-the-fly pair synthesis.
limitations: No paired ground truth for much real-image evaluation and no document or music-semantic correctness analysis.
relevance_to_tfg: Shows why realistic degradation and ringing controls matter while marking blind perceptual SR as a high-risk contrast.

full_reference: Chen, X., Wang, X., Zhou, J., Qiao, Y., and Dong, C. (2023). Activating More Pixels in Image Super-Resolution Transformer. CVPR, 22367-22377.
data: ImageNet pre-training; DF2K and standard SR benchmarks
method: Hybrid channel window and overlapping cross-attention transformer
metrics: PSNR, SSIM, attribution range, parameters, operations
reported_results: Reports roughly 0.3-1.2 dB gains over prior state of the art in the paper's comparisons and wider utilized input regions under attribution analysis.
limitations: Large-scale pre-training and natural-image bicubic benchmarks do not establish score-domain behavior or executable suitability here.
relevance_to_tfg: Provides later transformer evidence for Phase 3 criteria without freezing a candidate or checkpoint.

full_reference: Zhang, J., Peng, D., Liu, C., Zhang, P., and Jin, L. (2024). DocRes: A Generalist Model Toward Unifying Document Image Restoration Tasks. CVPR, 15654-15668.
degradation: Dewarping deshadowing appearance degradation blur and binarization task inputs
method: Generalist restoration network with dynamic task-specific visual prompts
metrics: Task-specific fidelity, geometry, and recognition metrics
reported_results: Reports competitive or superior performance against task-specific models over five restoration tasks.
limitations: It is a multi-restoration study rather than pure SR and its text/document objectives do not directly validate music notation.
relevance_to_tfg: Shows that document restoration contains geometry and appearance tasks that must not be collapsed into controlled SR.

full_reference: Zyrek, M., Tarasiewicz, T., Sadel, J., Krzywon, A., and Kawulok, M. (2025). Task-Driven Real-World Super-Resolution of Document Scans. Applied Sciences 15(14), 8063.
data: University Bulletin, Scientific Article, COVID Test Leaflet, Old Books, and simulated MS COCO data
degradation: Registered real scans and simulated downsampling
method: Multi-task SR with OCR keypoint hue losses and dynamic weight averaging
metrics: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, OCR IoU, recognition and statistical tests
reported_results: Reports text-detection IoU improvements of 1.09% on simulated and 1.94% on real-world datasets with statistically tested differences while some similarity trade-offs remain.
limitations: Small document collections and OCR-specific losses limit generalization; dataset availability is by request and music notation is not evaluated.
relevance_to_tfg: Demonstrates that task benefit and aligned image fidelity can diverge and that real-scan evidence needs a separate protocol.

full_reference: Martinez-Sevilla, J. C., Cerveto-Serrano, J., Luna-Barahona, N., Chapman, G., Sapp, C., Rizo, D., and Calvo-Zaragoza, J. (2025). Sheet Music Benchmark: Standardized Optical Music Recognition Evaluation. ISMIR, 604-611.
problem: Standardized full-page optical music recognition evaluation
data: SMB; 685 pages reported by the paper and official card
degradation: Original digitized page variation; no SR degradation protocol
method: Dataset and OMR-NED metric rather than an SR method
reported_results: Introduces SMB and OMR-NED and reports OMR baseline experiments; the official card reports one test split and gated access.
limitations: OMR outcomes do not validate SR fidelity and the reported metadata remains unaudited by this TFG until the separate authenticated audit.
licence: paper:ISMIR proceedings rights;dataset:CC-BY-NC-4.0 as officially reported
relevance_to_tfg: Provides score-domain provenance and semantic element context without converting OMR-NED into an SR metric or asserting audit findings.

full_reference: Kim, A., Jang, M., Moon, C., Shin, Y., Jeong, J., and Park, S. (2026). FiDeSR: High-Fidelity and Detail-Preserving One-Step Diffusion Super-Resolution. CVPR, 38270-38280.
data: DIV2K, Flickr2K, LSDIR, and real-world SR benchmarks
method: One-step latent diffusion with detail weighting residual refinement and frequency injection
metrics: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, DISTS, FID, NIQE, MUSIQ, MANIQA, CLIPIQA
reported_results: Reports gains on both full-reference and no-reference metrics and lower FID than compared methods across the paper's evaluated settings.
limitations: No music-score evaluation; generated priors and no-reference gains cannot establish symbol-level source fidelity.
relevance_to_tfg: Provides current generative SR context and motivates paired fidelity plus semantic failure checks without Phase 3 selection.

full_reference: Zhang, T., Duan, Z.-P., Guo, C.-L., Jiang, P.-T., Li, B., Cheng, M.-M., and Li, C. (2026). Time-Aware One Step Diffusion Network for Real-World Image Super-Resolution. CVPR, 30543-30552.
method: Time-aware VAE encoder and variational score-distillation loss
metrics: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and no-reference perceptual metrics
reported_results: Reports competitive one-step performance and controllable fidelity-realism behavior by changing the timestep.
limitations: Timestep control changes generative behavior but is not a guarantee of semantic preservation; no scores or documents are tested.
relevance_to_tfg: Current evidence makes the fidelity-realism control variable explicit and reinforces the need to predeclare safe interpretation.

full_reference: Li, H., Wang, X., Fan, Y., Zhang, Y., Wu, X., and Chen, Q. (2026). MMDIR: Multimodal Instruction-Driven Framework for Mixed-Degradation Document Image Restoration. CVPR, 8387-8396.
degradation: Random mixtures of blur shadow text watermark and seal
metrics: PSNR, SSIM, downstream document-task and degradation-identification measures
reported_results: Reports state-of-the-art results in the paper's single- and mixed-degradation document settings.
limitations: Not a pure SR study; synthetic mixtures and text-oriented downstream tasks do not establish music-score reconstruction fidelity.
relevance_to_tfg: Current document evidence shows that uncertain mixtures need separate treatment from the controlled SR core.

full_reference: Luo, M., Fan, L., Wang, Q., Wu, G., Luo, Y., Yu, Y., Chen, J., Wang, Y., Fan, Q., and Yang, J. (2026). Restore Text First, Enhance Image Later: Two-Stage Scene Text Image Super-Resolution with Glyph Structure Guidance. CVPR, 30553-30563.
degradation: Extreme zoom and synthetic text-image low resolution
scale: task-specific large factors including extreme zoom
method: Two-stage glyph restoration followed by glyph-guided image enhancement
metrics: Image fidelity, perceptual quality, text recognition, readability
reported_results: Reports improved readability and image quality over compared methods on the introduced and existing scene-text benchmarks.
limitations: Chinese scene text glyphs differ from notation and the paper does not validate staff-line or symbol semantics.
relevance_to_tfg: Shows direct recognition that small symbolic structure needs task-specific checks beyond natural-image appearance.
